profile.name: Abdulla Fahem
profile.summary: Software engineer with 5+ years building scalable web applications and APIs in PHP, Laravel, JavaScript and React. I work across full-stack delivery and Agile teams, and I teach deep learning and reinforcement learning at Universiteti Metropolitan Tirana.
profile.available: Open to engineering and AI collaborations

points: Founded and built an AI SaaS that turns a single idea into a ready-to-publish LinkedIn post or designed carousel in under 30 seconds.
Shipped style-matched writing in 12 languages, tone presets and plain-language AI refinement.
Built scheduling, a content calendar and team workspaces with direct publishing to LinkedIn.
Design and maintain enterprise software in a PHP/Laravel environment across full-stack delivery.
Build scalable back-end services and APIs, contributing to the front end where needed.
Apply AI and automation to improve system functionality and process efficiency.
Take part in solution design, testing, code reviews and documentation in Agile teams.
Support deployment, troubleshooting and continuous improvement of production systems.
Deliver lectures and hands-on seminars on neural networks, CNNs, RNNs, deep model training and reinforcement learning.
Develop live coding demos and reproducible notebooks connecting theory to practice.
Supervise student projects and prepare assessment and examination materials.
Lead software development strategy for a real estate and development company.
Architect and build the company's web platforms end to end.
Build web applications with Laravel and React.js across back end and front end.
Design RESTful APIs connecting back-end services with front-end interfaces.
Own databases, including schema design and optimization.
Maintain existing codebases and ship new features with sprint planning and code reviews.
Built government web applications including KQZ, SIM and the Elbasan Municipality parking system.
Developed responsive React.js interfaces that meet WCAG accessibility standards.
Worked with UX/UI designers and back-end developers on performance, security and scalability.
Delivered Veontime, Papaya and A-Tourism for clients in mobility, retail and tourism.
